title: Baby Leo & Friends Learn About Colors!
summary: Today, Baby Leo and his friends go on an exciting color adventure! They explore different colors in nature and discover how to mix colors to create new ones. Together, they learn that colors make the world a beautiful place!
lesson: Kids learn about colors and how to mix them.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, and Marjona sit in a sunny meadow. They talk about their favorite colors. Bella suggests a color adventure!
Twinkle flies in, glowing brightly. She says she can help them discover colors in nature. The friends cheer with excitement.
The group starts walking through the meadow. They notice colorful flowers, bright green grass, and the blue sky. Baby Leo asks, 'What colors do you see?'
Bobo points to a red flower and says, 'Red!'. Marjona finds a yellow butterfly and says, 'Yellow!'. They all take turns naming colors.
Bella has a clever idea! She suggests they mix colors to make new ones. They gather some flowers to try it out. Baby Leo says, 'Why not?'
They gather red and yellow flowers. Bella shows them how to mix the two colors together. They all watch as they discover orange!
Twinkle glows brighter, sprinkling magic around. She encourages them to keep mixing colors. Bobo finds flowers of different colors.
The friends have fun mixing more colors together. They create a beautiful rainbow of colors with their flowers.
They admire their colorful creation. Marjona sings a happy song about colors. All the friends join in with cheerful smiles.
At the end of the day, they sit together and talk about their favorite colors. They realize that every color is special, just like their friendship!
